title: Test-Time Scaling via Budgeted Multi-Attribute Verification
abstract: arXiv:2609.34322v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Verifying LLM-generated answers under a shared computational budget requires jointly deciding which candidates to inspect and which verification attributes to evaluate. We formulate this problem as multi-attribute good-arm identification under a global budget: each candidate is an arm evaluated along several costly attributes, and the goal is to certify as many candidates as possible whose mean scores exceed the prescribed thresholds on all attributes. We propose \textsc{BMA-GAI}, an algorithm that combines cost-aware arm selection with adaptive sampling of attributes. Every observation serves both to guide adaptive allocation and to support anytime-valid certification, which removes the need for a separate confirmation stage. translated_title: 通过预算化多属性验证实现测试时扩展

tldr: 该论文提出 BMA-GAI 算法，在全局计算预算下通过成本感知的臂选择与属性自适应采样，联合决定检查哪些 LLM 候选答案及评估哪些验证属性，实现了随时有效的认证，并提供了渐近覆盖保证与匹配的信息论下界。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes BMA-GAI, an algorithm that jointly decides which LLM candidate answers to inspect and which costly verification attributes to sample under a shared budget, enabling anytime-valid certification with asymptotic coverage guarantees and a matching information-theoretic converse.
